Our Mission Statement

We are dedicated to the preventative care, wellness, and proactive heath management of cats and dogs. For those who are weak, sick, or too old, we provide a compassionate sanctuary in Jaen, Nueva Ecija, Philippines. We ensure  that they live the rest of their lives with dignity, comfort, and love. ​

 Hiraya Animal Shelter is an independent 501(c)3 nonprofit that is not affiliated with any national organization. Hiraya receives no government funding and relies on donor support to provide our programs and services.

​​We would greatly appreciate your support.  https://www.hirayarescue.org/donations
